title: Corner question bank v1 (question-bank)
description: Schema for the per-topic question-bank files under assets/questions/ in a corner skill package. Describes structure and value domains only; no language-specific values — question text, hints, phase labels, topic labels and exam tags all come from the bank file itself. This file is byte-identical across language packages (enforced by a repository-level guard). Additional keys are allowed for forward-compatible extension.

$schema.description: Path from the bank file to this schema, so editors can complete and validate it live.

skill_name.description: Skill name; must equal the package directory name and the package config's meta.skill_name.

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code; must match the package language.

kind.description: Source genre: corner_script = full host script (icebreaker + 3 discussion parts); drill = prompt/answer card without graded parts.

slug.description: Bank slug; must equal the file name without .json.

topic_id.description: Topic id from the package config's topic_pool; null for custom topics not in the pool.

topic_in_pool.description: Whether the topic is already listed in the package config's topic_pool — same truth value as topic_id being non-null.

topic_label.description: Display name of the topic, written in the package language only; no other language (Chinese included) appears anywhere in a bank. For pooled topics this is the package-language segment of the config label, while any Chinese gloss stays in the config.

title.description: Session title, taken from the source document's title or its meta line.

source_doc.description: Source document path (relative to the repository root) for traceability.

source_title.description: Top-level heading of the source document; null when it has none.

exam_family.description: Level-tag family used by the source, e.g. DELF/DALF or DELE.

levels.description: Distinct level tags found in the questions, sorted B1 to C2.

level_span.description: Level range derived from the first and last entry of levels (e.g. B1–C2); null when ungraded (drill).

difficulty_span.description: Normalised CEFR range across all questions, computed from the per-question difficulty blocks (e.g. B1–B2); unlike level_span it also covers drill banks, which carry no level tag.

grammar.description: Grammar points practised in this session, worded as in the package config's grammar_points labels.

hint_label.description: Prefix label of the hint field in the source document (e.g. Mots-clés or Palabras clave); null when there are no hints.

hint_count_range.description: Per-question hint count as [min, max]; null when there are no hints.

question_count.description: Total number of questions; must equal the length of questions.

part_count.description: Number of discussion parts; must equal the length of parts (0 for drill).

phases.description: Phases in source order (corner_script normally brise_glace + discussion; drill uses simple / avance).

id.description: Phase identifier, taken from this package's config style.phase_labels keys (hence written in the package language, not normalised across languages); questions[].phase references it.

label.description: Display name of the phase in the package language, matching the config's phase_labels value.

order.description: Position of the phase in this session.

question_count.description: Number of questions in this phase.

parts.description: Discussion parts. A corner_script normally has 3 parts of 10 questions; drill has an empty array.

label.description: Part title with the number and trailing parenthetical removed.

heading.description: Raw heading line from the source document, for traceability.

question_ids.description: Ids of the questions in this part (questions[].id), in order.

questions.description: Questions in source order; ids run 1..N without gaps.

id.description: Position within the file, continuous across phases (does not restart per phase).

src_no.description: Question number printed in the source document; null when unnumbered (blockquote icebreaker, drill prompt).

phase.description: Phase id; must appear in phases[].id.

part.description: Part number; null for the icebreaker and for drill items.

text.description: Question text, in the package language only, without level tag or hints.

level.description: Level tag including the family prefix (e.g. DELF B1); null when the source gives none.

difficulty.description: Normalised difficulty of this question, independent of the exam family: a single CEFR band, so questions are sortable and filterable by CEFR alone. null only when neither a level tag nor a difficulty section exists.

cefr.description: CEFR band of the question; for a range such as B1 → B2 use the lower band, the full range stays in level.

source.description: Where the difficulty came from: tag = the per-question level tag; section = the section heading of a source that grades by section (e.g. Niveau Simple / Niveau Avancé).

hints.description: Speaking prompts in source order; empty when the source gives none.

answer.description: Drill items only: the reference answer from the source; other genres omit this key.
